steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each observation or near miss is placed by its action, its owner and its recorded cause.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 near miss has no cause recorded

findings.title: Near miss with no cause recorded
findings.fix: Record the cause before the next shift

outcome.notChecked: Whether controls work on the floor.

pros: Checks an observation with no action, an action with no owner, and a near miss with no cause recorded.
cons: Not checked: Whether controls work on the floor.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-safety-observations skill on the records for this review.
